# AGENTS.md

A launch page and API for one small tool, run with Flisk. Code lives in `services/app/web` (Bun, Hono).

## Check before you commit

```bash
bun install
bun run check   # typecheck, lint and tests for every package
```

## Generated files: do not edit

- `services/app/web/src/assets.generated.ts`: icons, from `services/app/web/brand/*.svg`. Rebuild with `cd services/app/web && bun run icons`.
- `services/app/web/src/video.generated.ts`: the demo video, from `video/film.json`. Rebuild with `cd services/app/web && bun run video`.
- `**/.autogenerated/` and `.flisk/.flisk-out/`: written by Flisk; gitignored.

Change the source, rebuild, and commit the result. `.claude/settings.json` blocks edits to `*.generated.ts`.

## Secrets

Keep keys in `.env` or `.dev.vars`. Both are gitignored and unreadable to Claude Code here. Never commit them.

## Deploys

A merge to `main` deploys: `render.yaml` has `autoDeploy: true`. Run `bun run check` first, and do not merge or push to `main` without the owner's go-ahead. Copies that deploy as a Cloudflare Worker use `wrangler deploy`, which also needs the owner's go-ahead.
